integrity: The universal proof uses the normalization genus, exact singular-point classification, sign symmetries, and formal local splitting. The finite-field computation is a replayable example check and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns only the three-singularity cases of the Moriya--Kudo (2,2,4) Howe sextic model in characteristic 0 or at least 7; it does not classify the generic five-singularity case or characteristics 2, 3, 5.
title: Three-singularity Howe sextics have basket \(A_1+2A_3\)
